command.name: adaptive-shape-runtime-builder
command.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Implement only Phase A from docs/reverse-engineering/shapeshifting-adaptive-runtime.md. Independently author a dependency-light adaptive-shape-runtime/v1 domain module plus deterministic Node tests. Phase A is presentation/read-model adaptation only: classify intent; validate a declarative shape; validate and apply bounded allowlisted shape patches to a copy; bind exact base-shape and policy/vocabulary digests; produce a deterministic preview; commit immutable version lineage only after an explicit confirmation artifact; keep data access none-or-narrower; preserve unknowns; fail closed on stale inputs, unreadable fields, unknown paths, executable/code/query/url/webhook/credential payloads, effectful/mixed intents, invalid scope authority, schema/invariant failures and tampered history. Do not add UI, model/provider calls, network access, database/provider writes, effectful automation, arbitrary code execution, Git mutation, deployment, or donor source/schema/test/asset reuse. Run the narrowest focused tests before returning.'

repairCommand.name: adaptive-shape-runtime-repair
repairCommand.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Read $SHIPPING_CONTEXT_FILE and $SHIPPING_FAILURE_FILE plus docs/reverse-engineering/shapeshifting-adaptive-runtime.md. Repair only the failing Phase A Adaptive Shape Runtime gate. Preserve presentation-only scope, deterministic guard authority, exact digest/freshness binding, none-or-narrower data access, immutable version lineage, unknown-preserving fail-closed behavior and the separation from effectful actions. Do not broaden scope, use network/providers, add UI/model integration, copy donor implementation, push, merge or deploy. Run the narrowest relevant tests.'

goldenPath.description: A presentation intent over an exact base shape and policy/vocabulary revision produces a deterministic validated patch, candidate shape and preview digest.
The same canonical intent, base shape, policy, vocabulary and patch semantics produce stable digests independent of object-key ordering.
A valid personal presentation patch can change only allowlisted layout/order/visible-readable-fields/filter/sort/group/named-card/named-chart/display-preference paths.
Preview records exact changed paths and a data-access delta that is none or narrower; it cannot widen authorization or source-data visibility.
Preview alone cannot persist; an exact confirmation bound to the current preview/base/policy revisions is required to create an immutable new shape version.
A stale base-shape, policy or vocabulary revision invalidates the old preview/confirmation instead of silently rebasing or applying it.
Effectful, mixed or unresolved ambiguous intent is refused in Phase A and never reported as successfully adapted.

Executable code, SQL/query text intended for execution, URLs/webhooks/network destinations, credentials, new formulas/metrics, permissions and domain-semantic mutations are rejected from the shape/patch contract.
Unknown path/value/field/authority/invariant state fails closed or remains typed unknown rather than being guessed.
A newly referenced unreadable field or metric is rejected even if it would be hidden later by the renderer.
Duplicate confirmation/retry for the same operation identity is idempotent, while conflicting reuse of an operation identity is rejected.
Restart/reload reconstructs the same immutable shape-version lineage and detects tampered/corrupt history instead of fabricating current state.
Rollback creates an explicit version/result and never claims to undo external effects; Phase A has no external-effect execution path.

excludedFromRelease: TriptoAfsin/shape-shifter source, tests, skill text, schema, branding, prose, fixtures, demo assets or UI trade dress reuse
standalone Shapeshifting Software clone or app-builder product
arbitrary SQL, shell, JavaScript, URLs, webhooks or model-defined executable code inside shapes
authentication, authorization, permission, domain-schema or security-boundary mutation
effectful automation such as sending messages, creating external records, spending money or invoking provider writes
team/org runtime mutation or two-person approval implementation
